editorial:
Imagine going on a romantic getaway with your partner, but instead of bringing flowers, you both brought a plan to murder each other. That is exactly how things kick off here. You get to follow a couple who absolutely hate each other but are pretending to play nice for one last trip to a quiet cabin. The vibe is a wild mix of dark humor and tension, making you wonder who will make the first move. It starts as a cat-and-mouse game between two people, but it quickly turns into something way more chaotic when some very scary strangers show up and ruin their plans.

What really makes this work is how the movie keeps you guessing with funny twists and sudden bursts of action. The acting is great because the leads make their hatred feel real, which makes the comedy land better. While some of the gore might be too much for some, it mostly adds to the fun. If you love movies that don't take themselves too seriously, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the couple realizes the strangers are actually dangerous killers. After a bloody fight, the husband and wife have to team up to survive. In the end, the wife manages to outsmart everyone. She kills the intruders and her husband, making it look like she was the only victim. She walks away as the sole survivor, finally getting the peace and quiet she wanted in the most brutal way possible.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark comedies and surprise twists.
